runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$7.07** a share (close 2026-10-16, `tools/run.py` quote source, aggregator, flagged). Shares **28,219,070**, one class (10-Q/A for Q2 2026, `0001654954-26-007668`, cover as of 2026-08-07; `Screens/cover_shares.py` the same; balance sheet 28,200 thousand issued and outstanding, no treasury shares; the proxy's 28,860,368 at the 2026-04-07 record date not reconciled with the March and May cover counts, stated in the run); cap **$199.5M**. Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury 30-year par yield, 2026-10-16). Documents read: 10-K FY2025 (`0001654954-26-002342`), the 10-Q for Q2 2026 (`0001654954-26-007589`) and its 10-Q/A, the 10-Q for Q1 2026, DEF 14A of 2026-04-23 (`0001140361-26-016374`), the 10-Ks FY2024 and FY2023, the NT 10-K of 2025-03-31, the 8-Ks of 2025-01-07, 2025-07-16, 2025-08-15, 2025-09-23, 2025-11-13 and 2026-08-13. Cross-check: FY2025 operating cash $34,863 thousand on the filed statement against 34.9 in `tools/run.py`. The brief's stated departures: lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7 (eight lines, listed in the run file); the 10-K names no rival, so Sanmina (SANM), TD SYNNEX (SNX) and ePlus (PLUS) read as a CONVENTION of the run. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)** **[M2012-065]**, **[M1998-044]**, **[M2000-105]**, **[L1993-023]**, **[M2002-092]**: one unnamed OEM customer 99% / 99% / 96% of revenue in 2025 / 2024 / 2023, the AI rack agreement unfiled and terminable for convenience by either party on 180 days' notice, the filer's own "Future power demands of AI-enabled computer racks is unknown" and procurement volume unpredictable, the business in its present shape since 2024 (revenue $27.4M in 2021 to $245.7M in 2025, 80% of 2025 low-margin procurement); NATURE because no unread filing answers what that customer will buy in ten years. Contrary evidence written down: fixed fees said to cover facility and debt service on termination, the two-year extension of December 2025, net cash of $51.6M. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: Adjusted EBITDA before stock pay featured, guided ($20M to $22M for 2026) and used in incentive pay; a material weakness unremediated at 2025-12-31; the late FY2024 10-K; the auditor dismissed; two late Forms 4; 2025 pay for the top three officers about $7.7M against $6.3M of operating income. Competitor row: operating margin FY2021 to FY2025 TSSI -3.0% to 3.9% (2021 and 2022 flattered by the factoring presentation), Sanmina 4.2% to 5.1%, TD SYNNEX 1.7% to 2.3%, ePlus 6.8% to 8.1%. Balance sheet: equity under $3.6M for 2016 to 2023 against a $65M to $68M accumulated deficit; $76.6M at 2025-12-31 after the $55.3M offering and a $7.9M valuation-allowance release; net cash $51.6M at 2026-06-30 (cash $67.7M, Susser Bank debt $16.1M), leases $22.7M beside; capital spending $8.5M (2024) and $32.7M (2025) on a leased facility for one contract, about $17M more planned. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash FY2021 to FY2025 (operating cash less stock pay and capital spending, all-equity, 21% statutory tax with the loss shelter valued separately) mean -$1.39M all spending, $5.91M maintenance case central (depreciation as the guess, specific (e)); twelve-month operating cash to 2026-06-30 -$9.4M as 2025's $10.5M deferred-revenue inflow reversed; (a) no cycle base for a two-year-old business, literal window used; (f) growth cut to sales growth and then to 5.43%; factoring fees kept inside owner cash and the eleven-year shelter valued, each a CONVENTION of the run; no case earns the floor at the price (4.2%, 6.4%, -1.0%); value **$5.98 to $8.08** a share all-equity against $7.07 (all-spending case $1.22; equity-only $4.38 to $6.59); fair **$4.64** all-equity, **$2.96** equity-only; not armed (box TOO HARD at Q1). Contamination declared by the analyst: one file-name search of the `Test Runs/` listing for "tssi", "tss " and "fortress" at the start, no match printed, a breach of the blind rule declared and not used; the MEC commit subjects, the AYI and ARCB folder names, `.gitignore` comments naming other runs and memory index lines; nothing about TSSI; none used. Commits 5f0092bf (template), e279f781 (Step 0, Q1), cb3bd014 (close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `tssi_check.py` PASS (32 distinct ids, 22 fragments); the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, 21 fragments beside an id, one flag ("rapid technological change" beside **[M2012-065]**) verified clean: the words are the 10-K's, attributed to Item 1A, with the rows listed after the attribution: **no slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) customer concentration has no home question, readable at Q1, Q2 or Q9, so two analysts could close the same file at Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE) or Q2 OUT; (2) Q7 (e) against (f): how much growth spending to charge against growth (f) has cut to the discount rate; (3) (a) assumes a cycle exists; (4) the shelter convention for a carryforward running about eleven years; (5) receivables factoring unnamed in the all-equity basis; (6) the equity-only fair price credits a large cash pile only through its interest; (7) a template line forbidding a first-step search for an earlier file. Could not get: the customer agreement and its term, the customer's name (a director appointed 2025-11-11 was then a Dell executive, recorded as a fact only), the proxy share count's reconciliation, 2021 and 2022 interest income (untagged, taken as zero).
runs.narr: TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1 (TSS, Inc., Nasdaq TSSI; AI rack integration, IT procurement and facilities management for one Fortune 100 OEM customer). One unnamed customer 99% of 2025 revenue on an unfiled agreement terminable on 180 days' notice, AI rack power demands "unknown" on the filer's own words, the business two years old in its present shape. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: Adjusted EBITDA before stock pay guided and used in incentive pay, an unremediated material weakness, the late FY2024 10-K, the auditor dismissed. Computation beneath the stop: value $5.98 to $8.08 all-equity against $7.07, fair $4.64 all-equity ($2.96 equity-only), no case earning the floor; not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: customer concentration with no home question, (e) against (f), (a) with no cycle, an eleven-year shelter, factoring in the all-equity basis, the equity-only figure on a cash pile, a template line against a first-step file search.
